title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Solutions Towards a Better Future programme will work in Centre Department and Port-au-Prince City, Haiti. It aims to contribute to Concern Haiti’s Durable Solutions thematic programme, and the goal of the grant is to increase the socio-economic resilience and self-reliance of the most vulnerable displacement-affected households through improved access to diversified livelihoods and improved social capital. The programme will support over 18,500 people living in Extreme poor households, female headed households, households with disabled members, youth, IDPs. This will be done through improved access to business knowledge and skills, adoption of climate-smart agricultural practices among displaced and host communities, strengthened and more inclusive urban rural trade linkages for increased returns on livelihoods assets and effort and increased programme and community knowledge of root causes of conflict and links to displacement.. Gender equality 2: this is the main objective of the outcome, which is aimed at addressing gender inequitable attitudes among targeted communities. Capacity Building 1: This outcome includes training for Protection Focal Points on Psychosocial First Aid (PFA) and Community Psychosocial Care, and over the course of the programme cycle, a trained pool of PFPs (from within the PFPs) will lead community group psychosocial sessions.
